name: zk-circuits
description: ZK-BEW: Zero-Knowledge Behavior-Entangled Watermark Proof circuits for DICOM-Trace. IEEE research artifact.

scripts.test:witness: node -e "const {generateWitness} = require('./scripts/generate_witness.js'); const crypto = require('crypto'); const pixels = Array.from({length:64}, ()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*256)); const w = generateWitness({pixels, kDevice: crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'), phi: crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'), hPrev: crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'), entropyMu: 6.5, entropySigma: 0.4}); console.log('Witness generated OK. Entropy in bounds:', w.pixel_entropy >= w.entropy_lo && w.pixel_entropy <= w.entropy_hi);"
